subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
In a 4-bit counter type ADC, applied input analog
voltage is VAN = 2.35 volt. If resolution of DAC used
in designing of counter type ADC is 0.4 Volt, then
digital output corresponding to applied analog input
is
(a)
(0110)2 
(b) (1100)2
(c)
(0101)2 
(d) (1010)2
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-14 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 14).
